$comment: Single source for the site's colours. Edit here, then run `node tools/sync-tokens.mjs` (it rewrites only the /* tokens:begin */ ... /* tokens:end */ blocks in css/site.css and css/oksat.css, and the fills in images/favicon.svg). Never hand-edit between the markers. `node tools/sync-tokens.mjs --check` fails when anything is out of date. Values are hex; keys are the site's token names without the leading --.

oksat.$comment: --ok-* mirror for css/oksat.css. A value is either a site token name (resolved in the same theme) or a literal #hex for OKSAT-only colours and for the one site-divergent value (dark --ok-border is not the site's rule).

favicon.$comment: images/favicon.svg: rect fill and circle stroke. dark signal is the mark, light ink the plate.

contrastExceptions.reason: Fails WCAG AA (3.65:1, needs 4.5:1) in dark mode: #FAFAF7 text on the #F03E4D signal. Used by ::selection in css/site.css. Known and left as is; changing it is an owner decision, not this pipeline's.
